name: Izuna Zanshinken
source: Koutarou arrives in Yuunagi City, in order to enter the service of the Kuzuryuu yakuza family.  A slender young man with an apparently innocent manner, he reveals the other side of his nature during a rather abrupt test from his new 'owner', his cold eyes promising death.  He is there to replace his father as Izuna for Yuunagi City, claiming the lives of true villains at the orders of his new master.
translation: 光太郎来到夕凪市，准备为九头龙黑帮家族效力。他外表清秀、看似无辜，但新“主人”突如其来的考验揭示其本性：冰冷的眼神许诺死亡。他前来接替父亲，成为夕凪市的伊纲，奉新主人之命夺走真正恶人的性命。
